Free Online Tools & AI Tools Directory

Merge and split PDFs, compress and resize images, make barcodes and QR codes, and explore 142+ AI tools with pricing and features. The free tools run in your browser, so your files stay private.

Featured AI tools

  • ChatGPT: OpenAI's flagship conversational AI. Write, code, analyze, brainstorm — the most versatile AI assistant.
  • Jasper AI: Enterprise-grade AI writing assistant for marketing copy, blog posts, social media, and brand content.
  • Grammarly: AI writing assistant that checks grammar, style, tone, and clarity across all your apps.
  • Midjourney: Create stunning, hyper-realistic AI art and images via Discord. The gold standard of AI image generation.
  • DALL-E 3: OpenAI's image generation model with exceptional text-to-image accuracy integrated in ChatGPT.
  • GitHub Copilot: AI pair programmer that suggests code completions and entire functions in real-time inside your editor.
  • Cursor: AI-first code editor built on VS Code. Chat with your codebase, edit with AI, generate entire features.
  • Runway ML: Professional AI video editing and generation platform used by filmmakers and creative professionals.
  • Luma AI: State-of-the-art AI video generation with Dream Machine. Create cinematic videos from text.
  • Sora: OpenAI's revolutionary text-to-video AI model that creates realistic minute-long videos.
  • ElevenLabs: Ultra-realistic AI voice synthesis and cloning. Create natural voiceovers in 29 languages.
  • Claude AI: Anthropic's safety-focused AI assistant. Excellent at analysis, writing, and nuanced conversations.
  • Google Gemini: Google's most capable multimodal AI with real-time web access and deep Google integration.
  • Claude Code: Anthropic's agentic coding tool that works in your terminal, IDE and the web to read, edit and run code.
  • Google Veo: Google DeepMind's video generation model with native audio, available through Gemini and Flow.
  • Lovable: Describe an app in plain English and get a working full-stack web app you can iterate on and deploy.
  • NotebookLM: Google's research notebook: upload your sources and get grounded answers, summaries and audio overviews.
